ai_view.directive: Follow as written. Revoke the evidence contribution first; revoke or downgrade a qualification only if remaining admissible evidence no longer establishes the claim; preserve every independently sufficient conclusion.
ai_view.specification: Refine the in-build uncertainty-propagation spec (naya5/uncertainty-propagation) with the selective revocation discipline: four-fact evidence distinction (historical existence / observed content / current eligibility / factual correctness); append-only eligibility-change receipts; six-verdict recomputation (UNAFFECTED/REQUALIFIED/DOWNGRADED/INSUFFICIENT_DATA/SUSPENDED/REVOKED) applied to certification standing, not truth; AND/OR semantics with false-independence detection (E2 secretly deriving from E1); partial-scope preservation (staging vs production); selective propagation per upstream event type (smallest defensible affected closure); two-stage incremental versioned recomputation (CONNECT impact discovery → PROVE+VERIFY recomputation) in topological order with fixed-point cycle handling and evidence-policy snapshot consistency; use-time eligibility enforcement at the commit boundary (T1-T4 race); immutable historical receipts with the 11-field revision record; machine-readable revocation receipt; ten acceptance tests; the bounded incident experiment (E1 exposed → A loses, B survives via E2, C narrows to staging, stale successor package rejected).

intelligence.applicability: Every evidence eligibility change in NayaNET — exposures, contaminations, expired qualifications, conflicts, revoked sources — and every claim depending on affected evidence.

decisions: Shawn's explicit framework, main chat, 2026-10-10. His word IS the verification (Verification Law).
Folded as a REFINEMENT of the in-build uncertainty-propagation layer (dispatched ~1 min prior) — the framework calls itself 'the highest-value next refinement,' not a new layer.
intelligence.essence: Evidence remains historically preserved. Its eligibility can change. Qualifications are recomputed. Only genuinely unsupported conclusions lose their standing. Revoke the evidence contribution first — never the history, never the unrelated conclusions. A compromised blind fixture may remain useful for debugging; an expired qualification may still describe history accurately; neither makes the underlying observation false. Recompute the evidence graph, not the labels: traversal finds what may be affected, recalculation decides what remains supported. An ineligible source may sit in a valid claim's ancestry without remaining necessary to it. The collective intelligence that can correct mistakes without forgetting what it genuinely knows says: 'This source can no longer certify the original claim. Two dependent conclusions lost support. One remains valid through independent evidence. Another holds only in a narrower scope. Here are the receipts, the unresolved questions, and the exact actions affected.'
intelligence.falsifier: Deleting the compromised source instead of revoking its contribution; marking every downstream object REVOKED when an independent alternative survives; inheriting the weakest ancestor's status mechanically; a cached successor package restoring an expired qualification; a consequential ACT executing on a revoked qualification (the T1-T4 race); overwriting a historical PASS receipt instead of appending the revision.

human_view.meaning: When a source loses its credibility, don't burn the library down. Take away its right to certify — but keep the books it already wrote, because the observations might still be true. Then walk through every conclusion that depended on it and re-grade each one honestly: some fail, some survive on other evidence, some shrink to a narrower claim. Never punish a conclusion that stands on its own feet just because it once stood next to a fallen source. And at the moment of action, check the credentials again — a plan made yesterday with yesterday's proof doesn't get to execute today on revoked evidence.

intelligence.learning_lesson: This completes the honesty discipline's correction half: SN-0780/0781/0782 establish, preserve, and propagate; this one CORRECTS — selectively, auditably, without amnesia. The four-fact distinction (existence/content/eligibility/correctness) is the permanent antidote to the laziest failure mode in the stack: treating 'ineligible' as 'false' and 'revoked' as 'deleted.'

machine_view.spec_only: Framework ratified; refines the in-build uncertainty-propagation spec. Not wired into live paths until the integration phases reach it.

intelligence.measurement_contract: Ten acceptance tests: E1 ineligible + E2 independent → requalify via E2; E1/E2 shared origin → false independence detected; AND-premise ineligible → path lost; production invalidated + staging valid → downgrade to staging; blind fixture exposed → certification removed, diagnostic use preserved; possible contamination unresolved → suspended not cleared; hypothesis loses evidence → recompute without inventing for the other; historical note repeats old PASS → projection cannot restore; cached decision on revoked evidence → use-time enforcement rejects; cold successor → same updated statuses. The key adversarial test: partial revocation with independent alternative — reject the compromised contribution AND preserve the independently qualified conclusion; blanket REVOKED fails as surely as ignoring the revocation. Bounded experiment: E1 exposed, A loses, B survives via E2, C narrows to staging, stale successor package rejected and reconstructed from canonical evidence.

naya_view.directive: Distinguish the four facts for every eligibility change and append the receipt — never overwrite history. Recompute in topological order with fixed-point cycle handling under a consistent evidence-policy snapshot. Apply the six verdicts to certification standing, never as truth claims. Preserve partial-scope conclusions with their original quantifiers. Propagate selectively per upstream event type — smallest defensible closure. Enforce eligibility at the commit boundary for consequential use; unrelated authorized actions continue. Keep the 11-field revision record for every requalification.

simple_view.meaning: Take away the bad source's badge, keep its old work on file, re-grade everything that used it — and only fail what truly can't stand without it.

intelligence.successor_effect: A cold successor inherits the selective-recomputation discipline: it reconstructs the same updated claim statuses and surviving support paths from canonical evidence, never restoring expired qualifications from stale packages.
intelligence.uncertainty: Framework ratified; spec refinement not yet built. Merge point is the uncertainty-propagation spec's recomputation section (§8).
